# Concurrent bonds
This fixture is the minimal R31-022 identity test. One agent owns three concurrent work subthreads in one room. The third bond demonstrates that the identity grammar is extensible beyond the two-task example.
The only valid routing key is `(agent_id, room_id, subthread_root, work_uid)`; `(agent_id, room_id)` alone is invalid. `routing.json` gives the no-mixing assertions for roots 42, 57 and 91.
